home.headline: Create more. Work smarter. Live better.
home.subtitle: Join the ranks of AI-driven creators shaping the future. Learn how to leverage creativity and technology to build meaningful work in the age of artificial intelligence.
home.movementSubtitle: Future-proof yourself with these tools and insights
home.bioParagraph1: "Zizai" is more than my name — it's a way of life I keep pursuing: staying clear-headed in a complex world, preserving human agency amid technological change, and finding my own rhythm between creation and learning.
home.bioParagraph2: I'm a creator and indie developer, also a lifelong learner. I've long focused on how product, technology, and expression together shape human experience. Now I'm more focused on how individuals can reorganize work, learning, and creation in the AI era.
home.bioParagraph3: What I care about isn't how flashy technology is, but how it helps a person better understand the world, train judgment, boost creativity, and ultimately live more awake and free.

about.title: About Zizai Blog
about.tagline: A Chinese blog helping you stay competitive in the AI era
about.missionP1: As AI reshapes every industry, traditional career paths fade, and the very definition of "making it" is rewritten, we need a new way to build our careers and lives.
about.missionP2: Zizai Blog helps you navigate this transformation. We explore the intersection of technology, creativity, and entrepreneurship to help you build a one-person business that thrives in the age of AI.
about.missionP3: Our content focuses on three pillars: learning (acquiring new skills fast), persuasion (building an audience and attracting opportunities), and execution (turning ideas into reality with modern tools and automation).
about.authorP1: Zizai Li is the author of Zizai Blog, sharing hands-on experience with AI tools, writing methods, and building a one-person business — exploring how technology amplifies individual creativity.
about.authorP2: He believes individual creators can build sustainable online businesses with AI and automation — without sacrificing creative autonomy or personal freedom.
about.learn1Desc: Master working with AI tools to boost productivity and creativity — prompt engineering and automation strategies.
about.learn2Desc: Sharpen your writing to create compelling content that attracts and keeps readers — from newsletters to long-form articles.
about.learn3Desc: Build and grow your personal brand with proven marketing techniques, attract opportunities, and monetize your expertise.
about.learn4Desc: Explore the evolution of human potential in the age of AI — discover your uniquely human edge and stay ahead of the curve.
about.ctaDesc: Get weekly insights on building a one-person business, mastering AI tools, and designing your ideal lifestyle.
